procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the fifty-one pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_90 (banner 'Official Recapitulation 2026 GENERAL ELECTION'; cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/hinds/). The county's recap carries THREE ballot sheets exactly as the certification note states ('The County Election Commission will prepare three (3) Official Recapitulation Sheets'): printed Pages 2-11 = the federal/state ballot (Senate, House 2, House 3, State House 70), printed Pages 12-31 = the district ballot in TWO groups (District Attorney 07, CoA 2 and 4, Chancery 5-1/5-2/5-3 on pages 12-21; Chancery 5-4, Circuit 7's sub-places on pages 22-31), printed Pages 32-51 = the county/local ballot (election commissioner, county courts, school boards). Every in-scope row's cross-ballot cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (12/12, 10/10, 7/7).
structure_note: Fifty-one-page three-ballot shape: p1 the certification/signature page; p2-p11 = the federal/state ballot over the county's 108 precincts (ten 11-column pages closing with Raymond 1..Utica 2 + TOTAL) carrying Senate, House 2 (REP-first ballot order), House 3, and State House 70; p12-p21 = the district ballot's first group carrying District Attorney 07 (five Independents), CoA 4-2 (David McCarty), CoA 2-1 (Deborah A. McDonald), and Chancery 5-1/5-2/5-3; p22-p31 = the district ballot's second group carrying Chancery 5-4 (Tarmetrice E. Hodges with the section header printing MID-BLOCK between his and Tiffany Grove's rows) and Circuit 7-1/7-2/7-3/7-4/7-6, plus the County Court 1 race's Carlyn Hicks row; p32-p51 = the county/local ballot (election commissioner D4, county court 3, school board 5 and school sections). Hinds STRADDLES congressional districts (House 2 at ninety-eight column assignments and House 3 at twelve, with PRECINCT 16 and PRECINCT 46 straddling the boundary -- their columns print values in BOTH races: Eller 23 + Chiaradio 459 at Precinct 16, Eller 92 + Chiaradio 791 at Precinct 46) and its chancery/circuit sub-places split the precincts (Chancery 5-1 at twenty-seven, 5-2 at twenty-six, 5-3 at twenty-seven, 5-4 at twenty-seven; Circuit 7-1 at twenty-seven, 7-2 at twenty-six, 7-3 at twenty-six, 7-4 at thirty, 7-6 at twenty-three -- X-celled outside each sub-district). Races: U.S. Senate (Colom/Hyde-Smith/Pinkins); US House Of Rep 02-2nd Congressional District (Ron Eller REP first, then Bennie G. Thompson DEM, then Bennie Foster IND -- the House 2 roster, names identical); US House Of Rep 03-3rd Congressional District (Michael A. Chiaradio DEM, Michael Guest REP, Erik KIEHLE LIB -- the House 3 roster, names identical, and Hinds joins Winston/Pike/Madison/Rankin in spelling the Libertarian 'Kiehle', where the sixteen other D3 counties print 'Klehle'); State House Of Rep 70-District 70 (Imelda A. Brown, Marcus A. Cheatham, James Lott III -- all Independent -- printed here alone so far, X-celled outside its Jackson precincts); District Attorney 07-District 07 (Gwen Agho, Greta Mack Harris, Darla Palmer, Marvin L. Sanders, Wendy Wilson White -- all Independent -- printed here alone so far; a district-wide office, IN SCOPE per the repo's historic DA rows); Court Of Appeals 02-District 2 Position 1 (Deborah A. McDonald -- TWENTY-SECOND county) and 04-District 4 Position 2 (David McCarty -- FIFTEENTH county); Chancery Court 5-1-Chancery District 5-1 (J. Dewayne Thomas), 5-2 (Crystal Wise Martin), 5-3 (Bridgett B. Clayton), 5-4 (Tarmetrice E. Hodges, Tiffany Grove) -- printed here alone so far (Warren's print will cross-check when its Chancery rows land); Circuit Court 7-1-Circuit District 7-1 (Adrienne Wooten), 7-2 (Debra Gibbs), 7-3 (Winston Lee Kidd), 7-4 (Faye Peterson), 7-6 (Damon R. Stevenson -- the repeated-court sub-place label family, with no 7-5 section on this print) -- printed here alone so far. Printed totals: Colom 63306, Hyde-Smith 14925, Pinkins 997, Eller 11879, Thompson 55618, Foster 2410, Chiaradio 5075, Guest 3883, Kiehle 156, Brown 1823, Cheatham 3427, Lott 2432, Agho 17087, Harris 12436, Palmer 20073, Sanders 12721, White 12052, McDonald 14379, McCarty 52447, Thomas 14070, Wise Martin 14922, Clayton 4595, Hodges 5887, Grove 28998, Wooten 14274, Gibbs 14838, Kidd 9561, Peterson 29362, Stevenson 7651.
operator_rows_note: All 29 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; the twelve federal/state rows carry p2-p10 cells + the p11 printed TOTAL, the group-1 district rows carry p12-p20 cells + the p21 printed TOTAL, and the group-2 rows carry p22-p30 cells + the p31 printed TOTAL. local_note: p32-p51 carry the county/local ballot: 'Election Commissioner District 4-Election Commissioner District 04' (Yemi 'Larry' Kings, Bridgette M. Morgan), 'County Court 3-County Court District 3' (Johnnie McDaniels), 'School Board 5-School Board District 5' (Patrina Dace) and the local school sections -- all local, out of scope. The district ballot's p22-p31 pages also carry two LOCAL county-court sections whose rows print on the same sheets: 'County Court 1-County Court District 1' (Carlyn Hicks, 20858) and 'County Court 2-County Court District 2' (printed header, its rows on the local tail pages) -- county court judges, out of scope, contributing no parse rows. accepted_roster_divergences.note: A one-letter name-spelling variance across the district's SEMS prints: Hinds' recap (like Winston's, Pike's, Madison's and Rankin's) prints the Libertarian's surname as 'Erik Kiehle' while the sixteen other District-3 counties print 'Erik Klehle' (Hinds' second letter carries its tittle at 220 dpi -- verified 2026-11-21). Kept as printed per source fidelity: Winston/Pike/Madison/Rankin/Hinds' CSVs record Kiehle; the other counties' CSVs record Klehle.

A multi-place spread the seat-blind roster gate cannot compare: District 7's Places print DISJOINT rosters, with no county carrying the union. Claiborne and Jefferson print sub-place 7-5 (Tomika T. Harris-Irving -- the 'Circuit Court 7-5-Circuit Court 7-5' sub-place label family) and Hinds prints sub-places 7-1 (Adrienne Wooten), 7-2 (Debra Gibbs), 7-3 (Winston Lee Kidd), 7-4 (Faye Peterson) and 7-6 (Damon R. Stevenson) -- Hinds' portion of District 7 is subdivided into five sub-districts, each electing its own judge, with no 7-5 section on this print. Each Place elects its own judge; each county keeps its own printed print.
